subject.title: fix(chat): keep proof decision out of actor closure

question: Should this PR's explicit proof lock/unlock lifetime be accepted as the synchronization boundary for queued chat cancellation and canonical proof observation?
rationale: The code fix is narrow and well proven, but the changed lock lifetime affects the ordering that decides whether a canceled queued chat message is confirmed as delivered or removed locally.

options.title: Accept Explicit Lock Boundary
options.body: Merge after the assigned chat owner confirms that holding the proof lock through result handling and outbox-change emission preserves the intended cancellation ordering.

options.title: Narrow the lock after SQLite decision
options.body: Ask for a small patch that unlocks immediately after the SQLite decision if marker update and outbox emission should remain outside the proof lock.

recommendation.title: Accept Explicit Lock Boundary
recommendation.body: Merge after the assigned chat owner confirms that holding the proof lock through result handling and outbox-change emission preserves the intended cancellation ordering.

likelyOwner.reason: He is assigned to the PR and owns the current-main history for the touched chat-cache synchronization path.
